source_binding.source_claim: K^*/O^* is the sheaf of locally principal divisor germs and, under factorial local rings, the sheaf of divisor germs

mathematical_checks.claim: The quotient is taken in sheaves of abelian groups and is the cokernel of the divisor map.
For every stalk A=O_{X,x} with fraction field K, K^*/A^* is the direct sum of height-one prime exponent groups.
For an integral scheme the quotient stalks are locally principal divisor germs modulo local units; under local factoriality these are exactly Weil-divisor germs.

The candidate covers the general locally-principal clause and the post-assumption factorial/Weil clause; the p.161 flasque/cohomology consequences are inherited prerequisites rather than remapped claims.
No analytic quotient, GAGA comparison, descent, projective-bundle lifting, or whole-section completion assertion is made.

mapping_review.reason: The candidate covers both source clauses under the source's factorial assumption. Existing_stronger is not appropriate because the extra flasque/cohomology results belong to p.161, while extend_existing would understate the exact bounded match.
